bail: Jarrah grip on the sill, two stainless posts 36 mm long, PTFE washers, 0.15 mm radial ferrule press. At a 300°C root the grip is 39.5°C.
broiler: Same plate as Caraxes, Z 100, Y 470 to 640.
solver: With the roof held, SLSQP reaches 31.7 kg at the 148 mm bound. Shop keeps 150 mm and 22 mm board.
note: Lift the hearth by the wood. The pit left behind is the fire, with the grate at cooking height or down on the deep rails.
